page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines; a library stamp at lower right and a digitiser's notice at lower right are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: Engraved ornament between "Indicibus aucta" and "TIGURI" is not text. The stamp "BIBL: STUD: ACAD: LAUS:" and the handwritten shelf mark at lower right are left out. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Some letters in the scan are damaged (e.g. "Defensa", "Instantiis"), but the readings given are the most likely.
